summary: The family drops a big hotel watch party and watches the returns upstairs at home with a few people.
realLife: On election night 2000 George W. Bush's family left the hotel plan and watched in the upstairs living room of the governor's mansion. Barbara Bush said it was hard to be intimate with 100 kids running around, and when her husband said the mood was worse than 1992, she answered with one word.
